missing_coordinate_rule: Either coordinate is empty after trimming whitespace
invalid_coordinate_policy: Record category and fail the run; never publish malformed/nonfinite/out-of-range coordinates as successful joins
unnamed_column_policy: Omit only after verifying the complete column equals the zero-based input row sequence

original_grid_unjoined_rate.failure_condition: rate strictly greater than maximum_fraction before rounding

unexpected_join_error_rate.failure_condition: rate strictly greater than maximum_fraction before rounding

coverage_gap_policy.action: Derive the missing cell geometry with h3.cell_to_boundary, join to a separately recorded supplemental grid, and retain the calculated index
coverage_gap_policy.source_for_assignment: source coordinates only; never copy from the reference

reference_validation.method: aligned streaming comparison with identity and all shared named source fields checked per row
reference_validation.on_reordered_reference: fail with an alignment error; do not silently compare unrelated rows
